headline: Hartford Insurance Group (HIG) Agrees To Acquire An Employee Benefits Business
summary: The Hartford Insurance Group (NYSE:HIG) announced an agreement to acquire Equitable’s Employee Benefits business. The deal expands The Hartford’s presence in the employee benefits market and adds new technology capabilities to its platform. The companies expect the transaction to support broader digital integration across The Hartford’s group benefits offerings. Broader consolidation and technology-focused deals across insurance and benefits are reshaping where income-focused investors look...
